status: Protocol contract; admission is recorded separately in the producer ledger.
scope: Protocol-owned interpretation of CallToolResult envelopes, independent of a consumer, provider or action judge.
declaration: Each interpreted tool declares form.answer-view=mcp-answer. A consumer must register the exact view from its already trusted capsule before selecting it. A document alone never installs a view or authority.
ownership: This view has its own mcp-result input family; it does not reuse or fabricate another protocol's schema or answer declarations. Existing answer wire forms are reused; there is no second cell or decision algebra.
coordinates: The host supplies source/operation/request.json as the last three coordinate steps. A batch retains each response's identity; missing or ambiguous identity refuses.
visible: text blocks whose type is text and whose text is a string, within read/items
withheld: Structured content without an interpreted output schema, non-text content blocks, metadata and undeclared fields remain opaque. withheld-blocks counts opaque containers and omitted content blocks, not bytes or primitive leaves. Empty text is an explicit shape.
limits: Existing read/response-bytes and read/items only. Missing limits refuse; a response batch exceeding its byte budget refuses. A consumer's narrower item limit increases withheld-blocks rather than silently dropping text.
refusal: Malformed envelopes, unknown offers, split catalogue or response readings, absent budgets and over-budget responses expose no content text. Read-only hints do not authorize an invocation.
errors: isError is protocol data, never a claim that an external action succeeded. Its absence is not invented as a false value. Invocation permission, execution and receipts belong to the host and its admitted rules.
sideEffects: No network, credentials, filesystem reads of source data, grants, signing or publication.
open: Image, audio and resource payload interpretation
Consumer view registration and pin admission
nativeHandoff: The response render region explicitly consumes region/server and region/mcp-response receipts. A native contract call with absent receipt selectors cannot acquire their data through the provider channel.
emptyInput: An absent response file emits no claims and ignores held response data. It does not assert a zero or a successful invocation; an unknown empty-file region refuses.
assembly: An exact local unsigned capsule and canonical standing with executable-offer closure have been verified. Producer admission, tag/version selection, release and publication remain separate.
